preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case is preceded by an empty line in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2])
preconditions.description: Each corridor description line contains two integers u_j and v_j (1 ≤ u_j, v_j ≤ n) representing bidirectional corridors.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == k and all(2 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][1::2])
preconditions.description: The friends' positions line contains k distinct integers x_i (2 ≤ x_i ≤ n) representing rooms with friends.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k < n <= 2*10**5 for n, k in [(int(x) for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][0::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (number of rooms) and k (number of friends) satisfy 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 2*10^5.
Each corridor description line contains exactly two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip().upper() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).
The number of output lines equals the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip().upper() == 'YES') == (any((all(x != room for x in friends) and len(adj[room]) == 1 and room != 1) for room in leaves) and any((min_distance(room, 1) > max_distance(friends, room)) for room in leaves if all(x != room for x in friends)))) for (stdout_line, n, k, friends, adj, leaves) in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(x) for x in line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][0::2]], [int(x) for x in line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][0::2]], [set(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][1::2]], [build_adjacency_list(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][2::2], n) for _ in range(t)], [find_leaves(adj) for adj in [build_adjacency_list(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][2::2], n) for _ in range(t)]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if there exists at least one leaf node (room with exactly one corridor, not room 1) that Vlad can reach before any friend can intercept him, regardless of friends' strategy. This means Vlad can guarantee victory by moving to such a leaf node.
